headline: Wall Street turns red on tech selloff; Nvidia plunges 14%
summary: The three main US indexes posted their biggest declines since April 2025 as technology stocks were liquidated. Nvidia shares fell 14%.
why: Nvidia is a leading supplier of AI chips, and its share price is a bellwether for the technology sector and US equity indexes.
why_moved: Investors sold technology stocks heavily, and the article reports the three main US indexes falling by their largest amounts since April 2025.
original_headline: Wall Street se tiñe de rojo por liquidación de tecnológicas; Nvidia se desploma 14%
